newsitem.title: USA: NOTICE OF SALE - Orem, Utah.
newsitem.headline: NOTICE OF SALE - Orem, Utah.

text.p: NOTICE OF BOND SALE WITH RESPECT TO
Sealed bids for the purchase of $6,000,000 General
Obligation Road Bonds, Series 1997 (the Bonds'') of
City of Orem, Utah County, Utah (the City'') will be
received up to 9:30 a.m., M.D.T., on
Sealed bids will be received at the offices of Zions Bank Public Finance, the Financial Advisor to the City, at its address listed below.
The Bonds will be dated May 15, 1997, will be fully registered bonds, in book-entry form, in denominations of $5,000 or integral multiples thereof, and will mature serially on December 1 as follows:
The Bonds maturing on December 1 of each of the years 2007 through 2016, inclusive, will be subject to mandatory sinking fund redemption at bidder's option.

Copies of the Official Notice of Bond Sale, the Official Statement, and other related information with respect to the Bonds being offered subject to the approval as to the legality of Ballard Spahr Andrews & Ingersoll, Attorneys at Law, Salt Lake City, Utah, may be obtained from Zions Bank Public Finance, at 215 South State Street, Suite 700, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111-2336, (801) 524-2100, fax (801) 524- 2109.
